    before being below between both but by can could did do does doing down during each
    either else even ever every few for from further had has have having he her here hers
    herself him himself his how i if in into is it its itself just let me might more most
    much must my myself neither no nor not now of off on once only or other ought our ours
    ourselves out over own per same she should so some such than that the their theirs them
    themselves then there these they this those through to too under until up upon us very
    was we were what when where which while who whom whose why will with within without would
    yet you your yours yourself yourselves one two three""".split()
)

    """re pre un dis non sub trans inter self over co con com pro de ex mis under anti multi
    semi bi tri en em in im ad ab ob per post super auto micro st ch sh pl tr sp cl gl bl fl
    sl sw spr str thr sc sk sn sm sq squ cr cy gr br dr fr pr wh th ph kn gn""".split()
)

CAP = 6  # englishness saturates at this many function words

# class: (base activation, slope per unit englishness), englishness in [0, 1]

    "english_prefix": (-0.05, -2.00),
    "letter_lower": (-0.19, -0.56),
    "letter_upper_consonant": (-0.29, -0.27),
    "letter_upper_vowel": (-0.13, 0.00),
    "consonant_cluster": (-0.06, -0.14),
    "two_letter": (-0.05, -0.18),
    "three_letter": (0.02, -0.09),
    "other_script_short": (-0.16, 0.31),
    "bare_space": (0.02, -0.20),

    if n == 1:

"""Approximate an abstract-noun response, not a general noun detector.

Generic goals, methods, problems and outcomes get positive values. Plurals
and nearby determiners strengthen the response; likely verbs, capitalized
heads and formula-like contexts weaken it. Noun-like 'need' and manner-like
'way' phrases get extra boosts. An abstract noun before 'of' gives a small cue.
European nominalization endings and direct Chinese dictionary glosses supply
limited coverage outside English. A negative baseline handles tokens without
preceding context, particularly programming keywords. Other positions are zero.

This is only a partial explanation, not an exact lexical lookup.

import regex as re
from functools import lru_cache
import wordnet
import cedict

GROUPS = (
    (.26, 'aim goal purpose objective intention motive desire need '
          'requirement demand'),
    (.19, 'way manner approach strategy technique method procedure process '
          'practice action activity step measure effort attempt initiative'),
    (.16, 'issue problem challenge difficulty obstacle hurdle drawback '
          'limitation dilemma concern'),
    (.15, 'reason cause effect consequence impact implication result outcome '
          'finding conclusion observation'),
    (.05, 'idea thought notion concept belief opinion perspective view '
          'argument assumption principle logic theory hypothesis'),
    (.11, 'situation circumstance condition event phenomenon trend tendency '
          'change development opportunity possibility alternative option '
          'choice decision'),
    (.06, 'aspect feature characteristic property quality nature essence '
          'meaning role function factor fact point detail strength weakness '
          'benefit advantage disadvantage'),
)
GROUPS = tuple((v, frozenset(words.split())) for v, words in GROUPS)
NOUN_CUES = frozenset(('a an the this that these those my your his her its '
    'our their any some no all each every another such what which').split())
VERB_CUES = frozenset(('i you he she it we they to will shall can could '
    'would should may might must not also only').split())
MANNER_CUES = frozenset(('a any some easy best better different same only '
    'simple').split())

FUNCTION_WORDS = NOUN_CUES | VERB_CUES | frozenset((
    'about after and are as at be been before being between but by did do '
    'does down even for from had has have here him how if in into is just '
    'least less many me more most much nor of on or other out over so than '
    'them then there through under up us very was were when where who whom '
    'whose why with within without'
    ).split())
CODE_KEYWORDS = frozenset((
    'int float double bool boolean char string void const let var class '
    'struct enum interface namespace package import export include pragma '
    'def function return public private static typedef').split())

    (.27, ('ungen', 'ung', 'keiten', 'keit', 'heiten', 'heit')),
    (.28, ('ités', 'ité', 'ità', 'idades', 'idad', 'dade', 'dades',

    (.26, ('ение', 'ения', 'ению', 'ением', 'ении', 'ений', 'ениям',
           'ениями', 'ание', 'ания', 'анию', 'анием', 'ании', 'аний',
           'ость', 'ости', 'остью', 'остей', 'остям', 'остями')),
)

@lru_cache(maxsize=50000)
def abstract_score(word):
    if not re.fullmatch('[a-z]{2,}', word):
        return 0.0
    bases = set(wordnet.base_forms(word, 'noun')) | {word}
    return sum(value for value, group in GROUPS if bases & group)

@lru_cache(maxsize=20000)
def chinese_score(word):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'\p{Script=Han}{1,4}', word):
        return 0.0
    for gloss in cedict.glosses(word):
        gloss = re.sub(r'\([^)]*\)', '', gloss).strip().lower()
        if any(gloss in group for _, group in GROUPS):

    return 0.0


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    doc = prefix.document_ids[-1]
    old = carry[1] if carry is not None and carry[0] == doc else ''
    token = prefix.token_strings[-1]
    text = (old + token)[-120:]
    lexeme = token.strip().lower()
    match = re.search('[a-zA-Z]+$', text)
    if match:
        word = match.group().lower()
        # Complete an English word split across adjacent token pieces.
        if (re.fullmatch('[a-zA-Z]+', token)
                and len(word) > len(token)):
            lexeme = word
    value = abstract_score(lexeme)
    if value and match:
        before = text[:match.start()]
        words = re.findall('[a-zA-Z]+', before.lower())
        previous = words[-1] if words else ''
        noun_use = (previous in NOUN_CUES or
            (len(words) > 1 and words[-2] in NOUN_CUES
             and previous not in VERB_CUES))
        value += .09 * (word.endswith('s') and not word.endswith('ss'))
        value += .11 * noun_use - .16 * (previous in VERB_CUES)
        value -= .06 * token.strip().istitle()
        if word in ('need', 'needs') and noun_use:
            value += .38
        if word in ('way', 'ways') and (
                previous in MANNER_CUES or re.search(
                    r'\bin (?:a|the|this|that|any|some) (?:\w+ )?$', before)):
            value += .72

                     old[-80:]):

    value += sum(v for v, endings in NOMINAL_ENDINGS
                 if surface.endswith(endings))
    value += chinese_score(surface)
    if not old:
        # No preceding context: a separate, usually negative response.
        value -= .29
        value -= .08 * (not token[:1].isspace())
        value += .16 * (surface in FUNCTION_WORDS)
        value -= .84 * (surface.lstrip('#') in CODE_KEYWORDS)
        value -= .14 * (not any(c.isalnum() for c in token))
    if surface == 'of':
        previous_words = re.findall('[a-zA-Z]+', old.lower())
        if previous_words and abstract_score(previous_words[-1]):
            value += .11
    return (doc, text), float(value)
